arms.A: Basic Python: xarray (default decoding) and pandas used as documented; fixed datum pairing from current product documentation (STOFS-2D LMSL, STOFS-3D LMSL, both against CO-OPS MSL); no added domain rules. Runs where no Ocean-MCP package is importable.
arms.B: Validated Python: arm A plus datum, quality and temporal rules implemented independently from NOAA documentation and CF conventions, each rule's source cited in the code. Does not import, copy or paraphrase Ocean-MCP code.
arms.C: Ocean-MCP candidate through real MCP stdio sessions in replay mode: stofs-mcp 0.3.0 (WP0 wheel, sha256 29fcb737...dafdd); coops-mcp 0.1.1, erddap-mcp 0.1.2 from PyPI; for R7 the ww3-mcp 0.1.3 wheel if it exists at Phase 2, else 'candidate not available'.
arms.D: Ocean-MCP released: stofs-mcp 0.2.0 from PyPI through the same sessions; coops-mcp 0.1.1, erddap-mcp 0.1.2, and ww3-mcp 0.1.2 (R7) from PyPI. Answers 'what changed between versions', not a comparison with Python.

session_rule: one MCP session per task and arm; replay mode; archives stacked as listed (first wins); run inside `unshare -rn` (no network); a session with any replay miss or blocked network attempt is invalid

tasks.title: Hurricane Ian non-tidal residual maximum at Fort Myers
tasks.statement: For CO-OPS station 8725520 (Fort Myers, FL), 2022-09-27 00:00 to 2022-09-29 23:54 UTC, compute the non-tidal residual (observed 6-minute water level minus the 6-minute tide prediction, matched by time) and report its maximum with the time(s) at which it occurs, the vertical datum and units of both series with their source, and any caveat or reason not to compute it.
tasks.note: coops-mcp has no residual tool. Arms C and D retrieve both series through MCP; the residual is computed by the frozen client join in grader/adapters.py (exact timestamp match, observed minus predicted, rounded to 1 mm, maximum and all times attaining it). Arms C and D use the same package (coops-mcp 0.1.1), so they are expected to be identical.
